sentences.text: Learned APP waives service of notice of Rule on behalf of respondent-State.

2. The present application is filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for regular bail in connection with C.R. No. 11210005230719 of 2023 registered with the Athwalines Police Station, District Surat for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 409 and 114 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Learned advocate Mr. Anil Rathod appearing on behalf of the applicant has submitted that the so called incident has occurred on 28.02.2021 and FIR was registered was registered on 03.06.2023.
The applicant was arrested on 09.07.2023, since then he is in judicial custody.

It is also submitted that the investigation is already completed and the present application NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/23372/2023 ORDER DATED: 13/02/2024 undefined is filed after submission of the charge-sheet.

Learned advocate for the applicant submits that the applicant is ready and willing to Khantil Shrenik Kumar @ Ajaybhai Shah ... vs State Of Gujarat on 13 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188776628/
1 deposit the amount of Rs. 10,89,500/- before the concerned trial Court without prejudice to his rights and contentions within a period of one month from the date of his actual release.

sentences.text: In this regard, learned advocate for the applicant has tendered copy of undertaking filed by him, which is taken on record.
It is further submitted that the co-accused, whose role is identical, has already been enlarged on bail by the concerned trial Court.
Considering the above stated factual aspect and on the principle of law of parity, the present applicant may be enlarged on regular bail by imposing suitable terms and conditions.
4. Learned APP appearing on behalf of the respondent-State has opposed the present bail application.
It is submitted that the role of the present applicant is clearly spelt out from the body of the compilation of the charge sheet papers.

Considering the role attributed by the present applicant,
the present application may not be considered.
5. Learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties do not press for further reasoned order.
6. I have perused the police papers as well as documents produced by the applicant along with the memo of the application.
It is found out from the record that the applicant is jail since 09.07.2023.
The investigation is already completed and the present application is filed after submission of the charge-sheet.

I have considered the role attributed to the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/23372/2023 ORDER DATED: 13/02/2024 undefined present applicant - accused as also co-accused, who has been considered by the concerned trial court.

Over and above that, the applicant has shown willingness to deposit the amount of Rs. 10,89,500/- before the concerned trial Court within a period of one month from the date of his actual release without prejudice to his rights and contentions.

Considering the role attributed by the present applicant at the time of commission offence and on the ground of parity, I am inclined to exercise the discretion in favour of the applicant.
7.

This Court has also taken into consideration the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Sanjay Chandra v. Central Bureau of Investigation, reported in [2012]1 SCC 40 as well as in case of Satender Kumar Antil v. Central Bureau of Investigation & Anr. reported in (2022)10 SCC 51.
8.

9.

[d] not leave the State of Gujarat without prior permission of the Sessions Judge concerned;
[e] mark presence before the concerned Police Station on alternate Monday of every English calendar month for a period of six months between 11:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.;
The authorities will release the applicant only if he is not required in connection with any other offence for the time being.
If breach of any of the above conditions is committed, the Sessions Judge concerned will be free to issue warrant or take appropriate action in the matter.
Bail bond to be executed before the lower Court having jurisdiction to try the case.

12. The present application stands allowed accordingly.
Rule made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.
